key_patterns: Backend API base: /api/v1/. RankedProduct from GET /api/v1/products/{session_id} returns {product: dict, constraint_results: Dict[str,str], ranking_score: float, ranking_confidence: float, explanation: str?}. The product dict inside has: name, price, currency, merchant, source_url, image_url, specs, constraint_results. ShoppingBriefResponse: {session_id, status, message, requirements}. CheckoutCreateResponse: {order_id, approval_url, purchase_id}. CheckoutCaptureResponse: {transaction_id, status, verified: bool}. TransactionResponse: {id, purchase_record_id, paypal_capture_id, status, verified_at, created_at}. PurchaseHistoryItem: {purchase_record, product?, session?}. Constraint result values are strings: 'PASS', 'FAIL', 'UNKNOWN'.
